create_HTTPClient: create an HTTPClient instance with a base URL, optional API key, and request timeout
test_HTTPClient_request: test the HTTPClient.request method with a POST request to a proxy endpoint
build_HTTPClient_with_auth: build an HTTPClient with a base URL and Bearer token for authenticated proxy requests
review_HTTPClient_request: review the HTTPClient.request method that sends generic HTTP requests and returns parsed JSON
refactor_HTTPClient_request: refactor the HTTPClient.request method to support additional HTTP methods and custom headers
